training_background_policy: Each clean current-fold training background is primary exactly once; randomized site-interleaved permutation, no replacement.
boundary_policy: Exclude training windows containing any flagged original row actually included in the frozen background array. Keep heldout bytes and add diagnostic flags.
physical_limit_assumption: Synthetic design limit: for every observed minute, sum(added energy)/sum(background energy) <= 100 (20 dB), for short and native references alike; not inferred from challenge Test or leaderboard.
